# Cosmos fork contract

Source revision: `2a1033aa2`. This contract freezes the cited interface and acceptance blocks of the specification. Statuses include the specification overrides. A source marked planned has line 0; a positive source line is verified in the pinned revision.

The context and decision tables reproduce the rules linked by interface identifiers. An anchor without a linked context gains no additional storage, gas, activation or pause rule here. Acceptance qualification remains UNRUN until its declared gate succeeds.

## bank-gateway

No interface block names this anchor; the citing criteria and rules below define its scope.

| Citing block | Field | Frozen criterion or rule |
|---|---|---|
| <code>acceptance.15.2.1</code> | req | 15002.1 |
| <code>acceptance.15.2.1</code> | scenario | Given a runtime.ServeMux with RegisterQueryHandlerClient bound to a QueryClient that records its request, when GET /cosmos/bank/v1beta1/supply/by_denom?denom=factory/pax1creator/sub is served, then the client receives QuerySupplyOfRequest{Denom: "factory/pax1creator/sub"} and the response status is 200 |
| <code>acceptance.15.2.1</code> | test | sdk/x/bank/types/query_gw_test.go::TestQueryGatewayServesSupplyOfByDenom (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.2.1</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15002</code> | ac_1 | The regenerated sdk/x/bank/types/query.pb.gw.go registers pattern_Query_SupplyOf_1 for GET /cosmos/bank/v1beta1/supply/by_denom beside pattern_Query_SupplyOf_0 (sdk/x/bank/types/query.pb.gw.go:853) and fills denom from the query string. |
| <code>acceptance.15.2.2</code> | req | 15002.2 |
| <code>acceptance.15.2.2</code> | scenario | Given the same mux, when GET /cosmos/bank/v1beta1/denoms_metadata_by_query_string?denom=factory/pax1creator/sub is served, then the client receives QueryDenomMetadataRequest{Denom: "factory/pax1creator/sub"} |
| <code>acceptance.15.2.2</code> | test | sdk/x/bank/types/query_gw_test.go::TestQueryGatewayServesDenomMetadataByQueryString (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.2.2</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15002</code> | ac_2 | The regenerated sdk/x/bank/types/query.pb.gw.go registers pattern_Query_DenomMetadata_1 for GET /cosmos/bank/v1beta1/denoms_metadata_by_query_string beside pattern_Query_DenomMetadata_0 (sdk/x/bank/types/query.pb.gw.go:857). |

Contract context <code>contract_context.15.baseapp_commit</code>:

| Field | Frozen rule |
|---|---|
| interface | BaseApp.SetDeliverStateToCommit (sdk/baseapp/abci.go:258), SetProcessProposalStateToCommit (sdk/baseapp/abci.go:254), planned SetSealedStateToCommit |
| storage | stateToCommit holds the CacheMultiStore written by WriteState (sdk/baseapp/abci.go:240) on Commit |
| errors | SetSealedStateToCommit returns an error for a nil multistore |
| events | none |
| gas | none |
| activation | used by node FinalizeBlocker only when the local sequencer sealed the decided block (wiring.J31.1) |
| invariants | Commit writes exactly one state per height: deliver, process-proposal or sealed |
| pause | none |

| Citing block | Field | Frozen criterion or rule |
|---|---|---|
| <code>acceptance.15.3.1</code> | req | 15003.1 |
| <code>acceptance.15.3.1</code> | scenario | Given a BaseApp at height 1 and a CacheMultiStore branched from app.cms holding key k=v in a mounted KV store, when SetSealedStateToCommit(ctx, ms) runs and then Commit, then a fresh query context at height 2 reads k=v and LastBlockHeight is 2 |
| <code>acceptance.15.3.1</code> | test | sdk/baseapp/sealed_state_test.go::TestCommitWritesSealedState (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.3.1</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15003</code> | ac_1 | SetSealedStateToCommit installs state{ms, ctx} as stateToCommit beside SetDeliverStateToCommit (sdk/baseapp/abci.go:258), so Commit (sdk/baseapp/abci.go:269) writes the sealed store and reads the header from its context (sdk/baseapp/abci.go:282). |
| <code>acceptance.15.3.2</code> | req | 15003.2 |
| <code>acceptance.15.3.2</code> | scenario | Given a BaseApp, when SetSealedStateToCommit(ctx, nil) runs, then it returns an error naming the nil multistore and stateToCommit stays nil |
| <code>acceptance.15.3.2</code> | test | sdk/baseapp/sealed_state_test.go::TestSetSealedStateToCommitRefusesNilMultiStore (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.3.2</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15003</code> | ac_2 | SetSealedStateToCommit refuses a nil CacheMultiStore with an error and leaves stateToCommit unchanged, so Commit keeps its nil guard at sdk/baseapp/abci.go:279. |
| <code>resolution.17.963</code> | title | decision.1504 binds: The sealed-state setter takes the sealed context as well as the multistore |
| <code>resolution.17.963</code> | applies_to | decision.1504<br>task.15.0.3<br>task.5.19.3 |
| <code>resolution.17.963</code> | source | decision.1504 in fragments/J56/decision.kvx; tasks from affects, tasks naming the affected blocks |

## gas-meter

No interface block names this anchor; the citing criteria and rules below define its scope.

| Citing block | Field | Frozen criterion or rule |
|---|---|---|
| <code>acceptance.15.20.1</code> | req | 15020.1 |
| <code>acceptance.15.20.1</code> | scenario | Given NewInfiniteGasMeter with math.MaxUint64-1 consumed, when ConsumeGas(2, "t") panics with ErrorGasOverflow and the panic is recovered, then GasConsumed returns math.MaxUint64 |
| <code>acceptance.15.20.1</code> | test | sdk/store/types/gas_overflow_test.go::TestInfiniteGasMeterOverflowSaturatesConsumed (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.20.1</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15020</code> | ac_1 | infiniteGasMeter.ConsumeGas (sdk/store/types/gas.go:231) sets consumed to math.MaxUint64 on overflow as basicGasMeter does at sdk/store/types/gas.go:107, instead of the 0 returned by addUint64Overflow (sdk/store/types/gas.go:92). |
| <code>acceptance.15.20.2</code> | req | 15020.2 |
| <code>acceptance.15.20.2</code> | scenario | Given the saturated meter of the previous case, when RefundGas(1, "t") then ConsumeGas(1, "t") run, then RefundGas leaves MaxUint64-1 consumed and ConsumeGas panics with ErrorGasOverflow |
| <code>acceptance.15.20.2</code> | test | sdk/store/types/gas_overflow_test.go::TestInfiniteGasMeterRefundAfterOverflowPanics (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.20.2</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15020</code> | ac_2 | After saturation the meter never wraps to a small consumed value, so a recovered overflow cannot be followed by cheap execution (sdk/store/types/gas.go:236). |

| <code>acceptance.15.21.1</code> | test | sdk/baseapp/occ_recovery_test.go::TestRunTxMapsAbortToErrOCCAbortWhenOCCEnabled (planned) |

| <code>req.15021</code> | ac_1 | runTx (sdk/baseapp/baseapp.go:853) wraps the recovery chain with newOCCAbortRecoveryMiddleware (sdk/baseapp/recovery.go:68) when ctx.IsOCCEnabled() (sdk/types/context.go:135) holds. |
| <code>acceptance.15.21.2</code> | req | 15021.2 |
| <code>acceptance.15.21.2</code> | scenario | Given the same handler and a context with WithIsOCCEnabled(false), when runTx delivers the tx, then the error is sdkerrors.ErrPanic and not ErrOCCAbort |
| <code>acceptance.15.21.2</code> | test | sdk/baseapp/occ_recovery_test.go::TestRunTxTreatsAbortAsPanicWhenOCCDisabled (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.21.2</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15021</code> | ac_2 | With OCC disabled a scheduler.Abort is an unexpected panic and reaches the default recovery middleware, which settles the open question at sdk/baseapp/baseapp.go:889. |

| <code>acceptance.15.22.1</code> | scenario | Given a scheduler with task 0 rerun so that it now writes key k read by validated task 1, when shouldRerun(task 1) runs, then task 1 is invalidated, lists dependency 0 and conflictKeyCounts[k] is 1 |
| <code>acceptance.15.22.1</code> | test | sdk/tasks/scheduler_rerun_test.go::TestShouldRerunInvalidatesValidatedTaskOnNewConflict (planned) |
| <code>acceptance.15.22.1</code> | qualification | UNRUN |
| <code>req.15022</code> | ac_1 | shouldRerun (sdk/tasks/scheduler.go:360) invalidates a validated task when findConflicts (sdk/tasks/scheduler.go:173) reports a conflict, through invalidateTask (sdk/tasks/scheduler.go:134). |
| <code>acceptance.15.22.2</code> | req | 15022.2 |
| <code>acceptance.15.22.2</code> | scenario | Given a validated task 1 whose read set no earlier task writes, when shouldRerun(task 1) runs, then it returns false and the status stays statusValidated |
| <code>acceptance.15.22.2</code> | test | sdk/tasks/scheduler_rerun_test.go::TestShouldRerunKeepsValidatedTaskWithoutConflict (planned) |
